facts.text: The Potsdam Promise offers guaranteed admission and a free application to high school seniors in St. Lawrence and Franklin counties.

sources.title: The Potsdam Promise | SUNY Potsdam
sources.quote: The Potsdam Promise is an exciting initiative designed for high school seniors in St. Lawrence and Franklin counties. Through this program, many students are eligible for guaranteed admission for Fall 2027 along with a free application
